Name: AutoTalkToAll
Author: vmu123
Description:
Automatically gives +20 friendship and mark as talked to on social page for all already-met villagers. Should work for custom NPCs added by other mods.

There is no configuration (No files, no GMCM entries, etc).

Made entirely with AI, for my personal use; I'm just sharing since I searched for it here and didn't find anything similar.

Manifest.Name: Auto Talk To All
Manifest.Description: Automatically talks to all villagers at the start of the day.
Manifest.Author: IMS
